criteria.criterion: Each iteration takes the first pending task (plan order) whose depends_on are all done, starts `/vloop:work <id>`, then runs that task's gate and every done task's gate in the plan's shell from the repo root with `VLOOP_ACTIVE_TASK` = the iteration's task and `VLOOP_GATE_TASK` = the gate's task; sessions never see either variable
criteria.evidence: iterate.go nextReady/runGate (cmd.Dir=Root, env set only on gate); TestRun09, TestRun37, TestRunGateEnvironment

criteria.criterion: A proposal or verdict that is missing or fails `proposal/v1`/`verdict/v1` counts as absent: no proposal → outcome `blocked` naming the files the session changed (scenario 40); no verdict → `rejected` (scenario 16); a stale handoff from an earlier session is never reused (17)
criteria.evidence: readReport validates schema; stale files removed at iteration start; TestRun16/17/40

criteria.criterion: Outcomes are `done` (gates pass, review PASS), `gate_failed` (no review is started), `rejected`, `blocked`; the last three set attempts+1 and notes = why; a task whose attempts reach `run.max-attempts` becomes `blocked`

Each iteration appends one `iteration/v1` line (run_id, iteration, task, attempt, outcome, gate, started, ended) to `iterations.jsonl`; `gate` is the iteration's own task's gate `{exit, duration_ms}` measured by the driver, or null when no gate ran; `reports/NNN-verdict.json` and `gates/T<n>.log` are written

After each iteration the journal gets the task's entry, `.vloop/state/plan.md` is re-rendered as `vloop status --markdown` renders it, and exactly one commit `[vloop] <task>: <outcome>` covers code, plan, journal, plan.md and the run folder; `.vloop/tmp/` is never committed even when .gitignore does not list it
criteria.evidence: appendJournal, render, commit with git reset -- .vloop/tmp; TestRun01

criteria.criterion: Before every commit the driver checks HEAD is still on the run's branch; if not it halts with exit 9 and commits nothing (`TestRunHeadCheck`)

The run ends `complete` (exit 0) when every task is done or `blocked` (exit 2) when tasks remain but none is ready, sets the plan status, and makes the closing commit `[vloop] run <run id>/<folder>: <status>`; the working tree is clean afterwards
`run.max-iterations`/`--max-iterations` stops the run between iterations with plan status `halted`, exit 4

Ported tests `TestRun01HappyPath`, `TestRun02ReviewFail`, `TestRun09DependencyOrder`, `TestRun16ReviewFailsClosed`, `TestRun17StaleHandoff`, `TestRun21ForeignState`, `TestRun30PlanOnly`, `TestRun37GateTaskEnv`, `TestRun40NoProposalTree` each assert everything their shell scenario asserts, translated into vloop's layout
criteria.evidence: all nine present in cmd/vloop/run_iterate_test.go with substantive assertions (read 01,16,17,40)

criteria.criterion: The driver never edits, replaces or disables a task's `verify`
criteria.evidence: no write to Verify in iterate.go
